name: Infyicon Icons for Elementor
author: infyicon

sections.description:
Infyicon Icons for Elementor adds an Infyicon Icon widget to Elementor. Drag it in, click “Browse Infyicon icons”, search the free Infyicon library (160,000+ icons in outline, filled, and color styles), and click one to insert it.

When you pick an icon, the plugin imports that single PNG into your own Media Library. Your published pages then serve the image from your site — so your visitors never load anything from infyicon.com, keeping your pages fast and privacy-friendly.

Features:

  • Search 160,000+ free icons without leaving the Elementor editor.
  • Filter by style: outline, filled, color outline, color filled.
  • One-click insert as a native image, with size, alignment, and link controls.
  • Icons are saved to your Media Library (no external calls on the front end).

Icons are free to use with attribution to infyicon.com. Browse the full library at infyicon.com.

This plugin requires the free Elementor plugin.

External services

This plugin connects to the infyicon.com API, but only inside the WordPress editor and only when you use it:

  • When you open the icon browser and type a search, it requests https://infyicon.com/api/search and https://infyicon.com/api/list to list icons, and loads thumbnail images from https://infyicon.com/i2/....
  • When you click an icon to insert it, your site downloads that one PNG from https://infyicon.com/i2/... into your Media Library.

No data about your site or visitors is sent, and nothing is requested on the front end of your site. Terms: https://infyicon.com/terms — Privacy: https://infyicon.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Make sure the free Elementor plugin is installed and active.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload.
  3. Activate “Infyicon Icons for Elementor”.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor, search the widgets panel for “Infyicon Icon”, and drag it in.
  5. Click “Browse Infyicon icons”, search, and click an icon to insert it.
sections.faq:
Do my visitors load anything from infyicon.com?

No. The icon you pick is imported into your own Media Library, and your pages serve it from your site.

Do I need an account?

No. The library is free; free use just requires attribution to infyicon.com.

What formats are inserted?

A transparent PNG (512px) is imported for each icon you choose.
